Settings_Description: Configure file matching, MKV output, and the default SRT-to-ASS style.
Settings_MaintenanceDescription: Maintenance mode does not create a separate backup. Subtitles, required fonts, and processing markers previously created by SubMux are protected; current cleanup settings apply only to other items. If protected items cannot be identified with certainty, nothing is removed and a warning is shown.
Settings_MaintenanceUpdateAssStyle: Apply current subtitle and ASS style settings
Settings_MaintenanceDetectLegacyHelp: A subtitle is treated as generated only when it has one Default style and that complete line exactly matches an older SubMux style.
Settings_MaintenanceLegacyStyles: Legacy ASS Style fingerprints (one per line)
Settings_MaintenanceLegacyStylesHelp: Enter the exact Style line from each legacy ASS. Case, spacing, and numeric spelling must match.
Settings_MaintenanceReplaceOriginal: Replace the source MKV after completion
Settings_MaintenanceReplaceOriginalHelp: The source file is replaced only after the maintained output passes verification. Failures and cancellation leave the source unchanged.
Settings_LanguageHelp: Language changes require an application restart. Korean Windows uses Korean; all other system languages use English.
Settings_CheckForUpdatesAutomatically: Check for updates when the application starts
Settings_CheckForUpdatesAutomaticallyHel: Checks GitHub Releases for a newer version. Network errors do not prevent the application from starting.
Settings_IncludeSubfolders: Scan subfolders when adding a folder
Settings_AllowSubtitleSuffix: Allow dot suffixes in subtitle file names
Settings_AllowSubtitleSuffixHelp: Links Movie.kor.srt or Movie.ko.ass to Movie.mp4. An exact base-name match always takes priority.
Settings_ConcurrentJobsHelp: Number of subtitle conversion and MKV muxing jobs to run at once. One job is recommended on the same drive.
Settings_ShowNotification: Show a notification when the batch finishes
Settings_ShowNotificationHelp: Shows a completion card in the lower-right corner of the monitor containing the application.
Settings_PlaySound: Play a system sound when the batch finishes
Settings_PlaySoundHelp: Notifications and sounds are not used for jobs cancelled by the user.
Settings_ConvertAudioToAacHelp: Only the selected audio tracks are converted with the built-in FFmpeg; video and subtitles are not re-encoded. AAC tracks that already meet the selected conditions are not re-encoded.
Settings_AudioChannelsStereoHelp: Mono and stereo keep their existing channel layout; only audio with three or more channels is converted to stereo.
Settings_AudioChannelsKeepAndStereo: Keep multichannel source + add AAC stereo
Settings_AudioBitrateHelp: AAC bitrates are 96 kbps for mono, 192 for stereo, 384 for 3–6 channels, and 512 for 7 or more channels.
Settings_SelectAudioChannelModeError: Select how audio channels should be handled.
Settings_AddSubMuxTag: Add a SubMux processing tag to the output MKV
Settings_AddSubMuxTagHelp: Writes processing information to the output MKV's global tags so files processed by SubMux Batch can be identified. Output files created with this option disabled cannot be processed in maintenance mode.
Settings_BackupMetadataHelp: Saves the complete analysis data and Matroska tags and chapters as JSON in a per-video folder under .submux-backup.
Settings_BackupSubtitlesHelp: Saves all embedded subtitle tracks in a separate MKS file.
Settings_BackupAttachmentsHelp: Extracts fonts and other attachments as their original files.
Settings_BackupExcludedAudio: Back up excluded source audio tracks
Settings_BackupExcludedAudioHelp: Saves source audio excluded by language filtering or audio conversion in a separate MKA. This may use substantial disk space.
Settings_BackupCommonHelp: Saves items in a per-video folder under .submux-backup without overwriting existing backups.
Settings_SourceCleanupHelp: Select which source items to remove or clean from the output MKV.
Settings_CleanMetadata: Clean existing metadata from the output MKV
Settings_CleanMetadataHelp: Removes the existing title, global and track tags, and video track names. If only one audio track remains, its track name is also removed; distinguishing names for multiple audio tracks and their language and channel layout are preserved. If SubMux tagging is enabled, only the dedicated SubMux tags are added back.
Settings_RemoveSubtitles: Remove all embedded subtitles from the source video
Settings_RemoveSubtitlesHelp: When disabled, existing subtitle tracks are preserved and the new ASS and SRT tracks are appended. Existing default flags are cleared so the new ASS track can be the default.
Settings_RemoveChapters: Remove chapters from the source video
Settings_RemoveChaptersHelp: Excludes chapter information contained in the source video from the result.
Settings_RemoveFonts: Remove existing font attachments from the source video
Settings_RemoveFontsHelp: Excludes font attachments from the source video while preserving non-font attachments.
Settings_AttachFontsHelp: Finds the installed Windows fonts and variants used by the ASS styles and attaches them to the result. If a required font is missing, the job is skipped with a warning.
Settings_FontLicense: You are responsible for verifying the redistribution license of attached fonts.
Settings_FilterAudio: Keep only audio tracks in the selected language
Settings_FilterAudioHelp: When multiple audio tracks exist, includes only the selected language in the result.
Settings_AudioLanguageMissing: The job is skipped if no audio track in the selected language exists.
Settings_UseAssStyle: Use the specified style for SRT → ASS conversion
Settings_AssStyleDetailsHelp: Edits commonly used fields. Style fields not shown here are preserved.
Settings_ResetAllSettingsHelp: Restores every setting shown in this window to its initial value. Nothing is applied until you save.
Settings_ResetAllSettingsConfirm:
Restore all settings to their defaults?

The changes will not be applied until you click Save.

Settings_EnableLapseSync: Automatically align the overall timing of external subtitles
Settings_LapseHelp: Only solid results are applied. After the MKV output passes validation, the synchronized subtitle is saved at the original subtitle location and the pre-sync file is moved to .submux-subtitle-archive. SMI subtitles are converted to SRT before synchronization, while the original SMI is preserved in the archive folder. Unsure or failed results keep the original subtitle and add a warning.
Settings_LapseUseEmbeddedReference: Prefer an MKV embedded subtitle as the LAPSE reference
Settings_LapseEmbeddedReferenceHelp: A suitable MKV embedded subtitle is used when available; otherwise LAPSE analyzes the audio. SubMux-generated, forced, hearing-impaired, commentary, signs, and songs tracks are excluded.
Settings_LapseSplitPenaltyHelp: Used only in Split mode. Higher values produce fewer splits.
Settings_LapseConfidenceHelp: The default is 8. Lower values apply more results but increase the risk of an incorrect synchronization.
Settings_LapseConfidenceError: Enter the LAPSE confidence threshold as a number.
Settings_LapsePenaltyError: Enter an integer for the LAPSE split penalty.
Settings_LapseLargeCorrectionThresholdHe: The default is 1 second. When the largest actual cue adjustment reaches this threshold, processing completes with a warning.
Settings_LapseLargeCorrectionThresholdEr: Enter the large synchronization correction warning threshold in seconds.
Settings_MaintenanceForceLapse: Force resynchronization even when already processed or source is unknown
